Chapter 2 Forecasting 2.1 One-Step Ahead Model vs Dynamic AR(1) Model One-step ahead we can use predict or forecast for AR(1). We use the estimates store command to store our results for our AR(1) model. Train the model reg unem l.unem if test == 0 estimates store model1 One-Step Ahead Model We can get one-step ahead just using predict predict unem_est Forecast - One-step-ahead forecast. We three addition commands: forecast create forecast estimates forecast solve forecast create forecast1, replace forecast estimates model1 For a one-step ahead forecast, static is our key option otherwise it will not be a one-step ahead forecast. forecast solve, prefix(st_) begin(1997) end(2003) static list year unem st_unem if year > 1996 Computing static forecasts for model forecast1. ----------------------------------------------- Starting period: 1997 Ending period: 2003 Forecast prefix: st_ 1997: ............. 1998: ............. 1999: .............. 2000: .............. 2001: .............. 2002: ............. 2003: ............
